sources.title: Tencent releases open-weight UI-Mate-27B GUI agent - korshunov.ai
sources.snippet: Daily ML news, summarized. Tencent has released UI-Mate-27B, an open-weight foundation model designed for long-horizon computer use across applications and operating systems. The 27-billion parameter model observes live screenshots to reason over visible states and produces structured keyboard and mouse actions for native desktop interaction.

sources.title: UI-Mate-27B: Image-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Model Overview Overview UI-Mate-27B is an open-weight foundation GUI agent with 27 billion parameters built by tencent for long-horizon task automation across applications and operating systems. The model observes live screenshots, reasons over visible state, and produces structured keyboard and mouse actions for native desktop interaction.
